Acceptance: Letterhead, cert no., date, authorized signature, seal present | Cl. 11 — Certification | OK
NC

NA
HOLD | | A3 | Verify pipe marking: manufacturer, IS number, class/SDR, size, date, batch
Acceptance: All statutory information legibly printed/embossed on every pipe length | Cl. 10 — Pipe marking | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. DIMENSIONAL VERIFICATION | | B1 | Verify outside diameter (OD), wall thickness, and length tolerances reported on MTC
Acceptance: MS: OD ±1%, wall -8%/+unlimited; PVC: OD +0.3 mm/-0; wall per class; length ±0.2% | Table 1 — Dimensions | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: Ovality ≤ 1.5% of OD for PVC/HDPE; pipe straight with deviation ≤ 0.5% of length | Cl. 7 — Form | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: Tensile ≥ 320 MPa; elongation ≥ 20%; bend test without crack at 6×OD mandrel | Table 2 — MS mechanical | OK
NC

HOLD | | C2 | For plastic pipes — verify hydrostatic pressure test (short-term, 1000 hr) reported on MTC
Acceptance: PVC: no failure at hydro test per class; HDPE: pass at 20°C / 80°C regimes; CPVC 82°C 1000 hr | Cl. 8 — Hydrostatic | OK
NC
NA

NC
NA

NC
NA
